subject: Project Nimbus kickoff - offline control without reward labels
body:
Team,

Kicking off our Contrastive Value Learning work. Internally this is Project Nimbus - use that on decks, calendar invites and the tracker, not "the CVL thing".

The substance: CVL learns an implicit multi-step dynamics model that can be trained without reward functions, and the model directly indicates the value of each action - no TD learning in the loop. Because the multi-step transitions stay implicit it never has to predict high-dimensional observations, which is exactly why it scales where 1-step model-based methods fall over.

Why it matters to us: our offline control datasets are large and almost entirely unlabeled for reward. Every method we've tried starts by demanding a reward model we don't have.

Apr 20 - Aug 3:
- May 29: reproduce on the continuous control benchmarks, offline only.
- Jul 3: run on our own unlabeled manipulation logs.
- Jul 31: adopt/park memo.

Alina has staffing. Rafael is tech lead.

Ulla
